name: gds-navigator
description: Open .gds layouts directly in VS Code with provenance-aware source navigation. Ported from superGDS Studio (fangrh/overages).

viewsWelcome.contents:
Start or continue a GDS project.
[Initialize project](command:gdsNavigator.initializeProject)
[Create marker template (50 µm JJ pad)](command:gdsNavigator.createMarkerExample)
[Set up Python environment](command:gdsNavigator.setupProjectEnvironment)
[Run current Python script](command:gdsNavigator.runScript)

GDS: Open Current File in GDS Navigator

gdsNavigator.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python executable used to parse GDS files and run build scripts. An explicit path or manually picked environment takes precedence. Otherwise GDS Navigator automatically checks installed environments and prefers verified provenance-enabled gdsfactory with klayout. Use **GDS: Set Up Project Environment** to choose or create a folder-wide environment and optionally install packages. Automatic detection never installs packages.

gdsNavigator.parseTimeoutSec.description: Timeout in seconds for parsing a GDS file.

gdsNavigator.usageLogging.enabled.description: Record local bounded usage events for workflow review. No network upload, geometry, instruction text, or clipboard contents. Disable to pause.
